comment: Gaussian-RulE configuration for Kinship dataset - Using Gaussian embeddings to solve gradient vanishing problem
_note_warmup: Stage 1: Initialize Gaussian embeddings, prevent variance collapse
_note_joint: Stage 2: Learn rule embeddings and dynamic confidence w_i(h)
_note_lambda_kl: KL regularization weight, prevent variance collapse
_note_target_logvar: Target log-variance = log(1.0) = 0, keep variance around 1.0
_note_weight_rule: Rule loss weight, loss = loss_kge + weight_rule * loss_rule
_advantage_1: 1. KL divergence is differentiable everywhere, gradients always exist (no matter how far distributions are)
_advantage_2: 2. Uncertainty accumulation: longer reasoning chains lead to larger variance (auto-model information decay)
_advantage_3: 3. Product of Gaussians has closed-form solution (automatic weighted average, no Attention needed)
_advantage_4: 4. No high-dimensional intersection curse (KL divergence doesn't decay exponentially like volume intersection)
